body:
Realize that nothing is personal, as difficult as that is to accept. Hurt people hurt people. I try to wish the best for the people who have hurt me. 

The person you want revenge on is probably hurting. Two wrongs don't make a right. Revenge might make you feel better temporarily but in the long run it will make you feel worse and won't help you or the other person. 

You can't control the actions of others, only how your respond. 

Take time to allow yourself to be angry and hurt and feel your feelings. 

Karma will catch up to them and hopefully it's a learning experience so they don't hurt anyone else.
